headline: IDF claims it killed 'Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior official in the general security apparatus of Hamas' (IDF claim)
dek: 7 killed across Gaza Oct 20 incl. married couple near Al-Shifa; IDF claims the man was a senior Hamas security official (unverified by others); teenager killed south of Khan Younis; cumulative: 1,522 killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire per Gaza Health Ministry.
sources: Gaza civil defence (Mahmoud Bassal), Al-Aqsa/Al-Shifa/Nasser hospitals (via Malay Mail/AFP); IDF (target claims); Gaza Health Ministry (cumulative figures, via TRT/AA)
fault_line: Does 'targeting Hamas officials' justify continued strikes under a ceasefire — or is the ceasefire fiction?

sections.what_happened: 7 killed across Gaza Oct 20 incl. married couple near Al-Shifa; IDF claims the man was a senior Hamas security official (unverified by others); teenager killed south of Khan Younis; cumulative: 1,522 killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire per Gaza Health Ministry.
sections.what_verified: Malay Mail (AFP), TRT World, AA, presstv carry consistent toll; IDF claim relayed by Malay Mail/AFP.
sections.what_disputed: IDF target claims are single-source Israeli military statements — never adopted as fact per editorial stance; Gaza Health Ministry is Hamas-run — figures attributed; Israeli military 'verifying' other reports (AFP).
sections.why_matters: A year into the 'ceasefire': seven more dead in a day, and the toll since October 2025 passes 1,500 — the truce holds on paper only.
sections.context: Background: Gaza — UPDATE (Oct 20 violation toll, reported Oct 21): 7 Palestinians killed across Gaza 'yesterday' — married couple Akram Yassin + wife killed in residential block near Al-Shifa, Al-Rimal (AFP photo of funeral); IDF claims it killed 'Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior official in the general security apparatus of Hamas' (IDF claim); teenager killed by gunfire south of Khan Younis; strikes in Al-Zawaida, Wadi Gaza, Jabalia al-Balad, Zeitoun; IDF also claimed Jabalia target took part in Shani Louk abduction; Netanyahu vowed to keep targeting Hamas despite Oct 2025 ceasefire; Gaza Health Ministry: 1,522 killed / 5,421 wounded in ceasefire violations since Oct 10, 2025

totw_analysis: Our read: A year into the 'ceasefire': seven more dead in a day, and the toll since October 2025 passes 1,500 — the truce holds on paper only. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Does 'targeting Hamas officials' justify continued strikes under a ceasefire — or is the ceasefire fiction?
